study type: Cross-sectional study (of human placentae) and in vitro experiments
outcome: Expression levels of STAT3, STAT2, STAT5B
Expression of amino acid transporter SNAT2
Expression of differentiation marker CGB/human chorionic gonadotrophin beta-subunit (b-hCG)
Expression of apoptosis markers caspases 3 and 8
cohort: The human study involved placentae from idiopathic FGR-affected pregnancies and gestational-age-matched control placentae.
finding: The study found significantly lower STAT3 mRNA and protein levels in placentae from idiopathic FGR-affected pregnancies compared to gestational-age-matched controls, suggesting that decreased STAT3 expression contributes to abnormal trophoblast function by modulating SNAT2, CGB/b-hCG, caspases, and TP53.
cross-section timing: Placentae were collected from FGR and control pregnancies, likely at term delivery.
gest_age: Gestational-age-matched controls were used, but specific gestational age ranges for the cohorts were not provided.
